node.title: Node
node.description: Node is the environment in which controllers and components operate, which can be a host or a container. The platform leverages the controllers on the nodes to manage the nodes and uniformly regulate the operation of the components.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The cloud region environment communicates with the platform through Nats Executor and Stargazer components running on proxy hosts or K8s clusters.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: Variables are used to dynamically replace values in configuration files, facilitating unified management and configuration reuse.

node.winrmHttpsPortHelp: The default is 5986. A custom port must have a WinRM HTTPS listener; 5985 is normally an HTTP port.
node.winrmHttpPortHelp: The default is 5985. A custom port must have a WinRM HTTP listener; 5986 is normally an HTTPS port.
node.winrmHttpPortError: Port 5985 is normally used for WinRM HTTP and cannot be used in HTTPS mode. Use 5986 or a custom port with an HTTPS listener.
node.uploadPackageDesc: Upload the installation package to any directory on the target host node.
node.uploadPackageNote: Note: This installation package can be run and installed on any eligible Windows host.
node.runPackageDesc: Run the installation package as an administrator and paste the installer session into the installation input box.
node.importantNoteDesc: Installer sessions are strictly bound to the host. Ensure that the session matches the current host information and do not reuse it across hosts.
node.linuxDownloadPackageDesc: Download the Linux installer binary for the current architecture, or use the command below directly on the target host.
node.linuxRunCommandDesc: Copy the installer command and execute it directly on the target Linux host with sudo privileges.
node.installerSummaryNoEvents: No installer detail events were received. The bootstrap command may not have reached the installer, or remote command output was not collected.
node.installerSummaryIncomplete: Installer detail steps are incomplete. Check the last failed or missing step before retrying.
node.installerSummaryConnectivityPending: The installer detail steps have completed. The system is waiting for sidecar to connect back. Check bk-sidecar.service, journal logs, sidecar.yml, token, server_url, and network access from the target host.
node.installerSummaryConnectivityTimeout: The installer detail steps completed, but sidecar did not connect back before timeout. Check bk-sidecar.service, journal logs, sidecar.yml, token, server_url, and firewall or DNS settings.
node.installerSummaryNoReportConnectivityTime: The platform connected to the target host and dispatched the install command, but no installer steps were received and the node did not connect back before timeout. Log in to the target host and check access to Server/NATS/object storage, curl download output, bootstrap command output, and remote output collection.
node.installerSummarySuccessWithoutDetail: The node connected back and installation succeeded, but installer detail steps were not captured. Check target-host install logs and remote command output if troubleshooting is needed.
node.installerSummarySuccessWithIncompleteDet: The node connected back and installation succeeded. Some installer detail events were not reported, but they do not change the install outcome.
node.installerSummaryDuplicatedEvents: Duplicate installer events were detected and hidden. The displayed detail steps use the latest event for each installer step.
node.installerSuggestionFetchSession: Check node connectivity, authentication, the node system time, and whether the installer session is still valid.
node.installerSuggestionClockSkew: Synchronize the node clock with NTP, Chrony, or Windows Time, ensure it stays within the configured Server skew threshold, then retry the installation.
node.installerSuggestionPrepareDirs: Check disk space and ensure the installer directory has sufficient write permissions.
node.installerSuggestionDownload: Check network connectivity from the node to NATS/ObjectStore and confirm the installer package is available.
node.installerSuggestionStopService: Verify that the installer can manage services, then check bk-sidecar.service on Linux or the sidecar service on Windows.
node.installerSuggestionObjectMissing: Verify that the package for the selected version and architecture has been uploaded, and confirm the package record matches the exact object-store key.
node.installerSuggestionBucketMissing: Check whether the object-store bucket has been initialized and confirm the server and executor are using the same NATS_NAMESPACE.
node.installerSuggestionConnection: Check connectivity from the target node to NATS and the server, including ports, firewall rules, TLS settings, and the node system time.
node.installerSuggestionCertificate: Configure trust for the failing stage: import the target WinRM issuing CA into the Ansible Executor, or import the installer Server HTTPS CA into the target Windows host. On a trusted private network only, you can also return to the install configuration and explicitly disable certificate validation.
node.installerSuggestionWinrmBusy: Wait for existing WinRM operations to finish. If safe, restart the WinRM service and check the WinRS MaxShellsPerUser and MaxConcurrentOperationsPerUser quotas before retrying.
node.installerSuggestionTimeout: Check for network latency, host load, and service responsiveness. Increase timeout settings before retrying if necessary.
node.installerSuggestionAuth: Check whether the current installer flow is using valid credentials and confirm the download credentials match the target environment.
node.installerSuggestionPermission: Check whether the current user has sufficient read, write, and execute permissions for the install directory and target files.
node.installerSuggestionFileBusy: Stop the process that is currently holding the target file, then retry the installation or upgrade.
node.installerSuggestionDisk: Check disk space and quota limits on the target host, free space if needed, then retry.
node.installerSuggestionPackageInvalid: Re-upload a complete package and verify the archive format, checksum, and package integrity.
node.installerSuggestionArchMismatch: Verify that the node CPU architecture matches the selected package architecture, and switch to the correct package if needed.
node.installerSuggestionExtract: Check disk space, package integrity, and whether the target directory can be written.
node.installerSuggestionWriteConfig: Check runtime configuration values and verify the install directory is writable.
node.installerSuggestionInstall: Review the installer logs and verify the target host meets the required runtime and permission prerequisites.
node.installerSuggestionGeneric: Review the installer logs and retry after fixing the reported issue.

node.installerFailureClockSkew: The node and Server clocks differ beyond the allowed threshold
node.installerFailureUnknown: The installation step failed with an unexpected error
